public_rationale: The Nature paper published on March 25, 2026 describes automated research and a generated manuscript passing an initial workshop review [e1]. An independent preprint submitted on November 17, 2025 reports one well-supported KOSMOS finding, one uncertain result and one false hypothesis [e2]. Neither inspected record establishes substantive model-led research, novelty and independent validation together under the contract's criteria [e1, e2]. They also establish no general barrier to foundation-model research, leaving the forecast unresolved [e1, e2].
limitations: Initial workshop review does not by itself establish independent validation of the scientific result.
The KOSMOS abstract does not establish the complete research contribution or the extent of human intervention.
The potentially relevant paper Closing the Empirical Loop could not be inspected.
The claim gives no deadline; a finite period without a qualifying example cannot establish its indefinite negative.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI foundation models will not do scientific research.

statement.excerpt: QUIP: AI Will Do Science Research, Somehow — No it won't, here's a writeup about why foundation models can't do this.
statement.document_title: How To Argue With An AI Booster

from_speaker: AI Will Do Science Research, Somehow — No it won't
our_interpretation: The plain reading is that foundation models will not independently conduct substantive scientific investigations, rather than that they cannot assist scientists at all.
A qualifying example must attribute the core hypothesis, investigation and analysis to a foundation-model system and independently validate the scientific result.
Human provision of tools, broad objectives, ethical oversight or physical execution is compatible with this reading; humans supplying the substantive scientific solution is not.
No deadline is stated. A finite period without a qualifying example cannot support the indefinite negative.
criteria.support_condition: No finite sequence of failures establishes this unrestricted prediction. Support would require a demonstrated general barrier applying to the claimed class of systems.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A dated, independently validated scientific investigation establishes that a foundation-model system performed the substantive research under the stated autonomy criteria.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A publicly documented investigation with methods, outputs and intervention records establishing that a foundation-model system supplied the substantive hypothesis, investigation and analysis, plus independent validation available by the evaluation date, would contradict the forecast.
